title: STACK CIRCUIT
oneLiner: Stack, rotate and clear twelve lines before the well overflows.
mechanics: Place seven distinct four-cell shapes to fill horizontal lines.
A rotates with bounded wall kicks; B hard-drops; DOWN soft-drops.
A landing ghost and three-piece queue support planning.
Clear twelve lines to finish. Gravity accelerates every six cleared lines.
Two players control independent boards with equal seeded bags; multi-line clears send bounded garbage.
lose: A piece cannot spawn or locks above the well; in versus the surviving player wins. The run also has a finite time limit.
scoring: Single/double/triple/four-line clears score 100/300/500/800 times level, with combo and consecutive four-line bonuses; soft drop scores one per cell, hard drop two.
note: Original catalogue foundation, no commercial source/assets.
